publico: International match in Milan with fans from both countries and visitors: English reaches the widest audience.

cenas.fala: Italy against France, at San Siro in Milan. Thursday, November twelfth, at eight forty-five PM.
Two world champion nations: Italy has won four World Cups, France has won two.
Getting there: take the purple metro line, M5, to San Siro Stadio, right next to the stadium.
After the final whistle the metro gets packed. Waiting about twenty minutes pays off.
Avoid scams: no bank transfers to strangers, be wary of prices far too low, and of screenshots.
